task: Project list status filter, selection, empty and error states

requirements.description: Labelled status selector (All, Active, Archived, Paused) above the list fetches the selected status via the existing API client and shows matching projects and a result count, in the prototype's structure

Selecting a project shows its name in the selected-project panel; selection survives filtering that hides it and is restored visually when filtering back; a successful empty result has its own empty state
Failed request shows the existing showProblem error with Retry, distinct from empty; Retry uses the current filter and preserves the selection

Use selectField/renderRows/showProblem; selection in app state independent of visible list; loading distinct from empty/error; panel not cleared on request/error; only the latest filter's response renders
Use existing --accent/--surface/--line/--space tokens with blue accent (not prototype orange); side-by-side on wide screens, panel below list on narrow; labelled, keyboard-focusable controls

checks.description: npm test: controller tests prove status reaches the loader, selection persists across filters, empty vs error phases, retry with current filter, stale responses ignored
npm test spawns the provided server with PORT=0 and verifies filtered results through the real API client path and the 503 failure mode via /__fixture__/mode
Source trace: tokens only (no orange), responsive layout rule, labelled select, existing helpers used
Open the actual app, change filters, select, hide/restore selection, empty (paused), failure + Retry, wide and narrow viewports
